scope: owned existing synthetic development Storage/Auth stack; one fresh private bucket and one exact path

capture.semantics: finite local capture ceilings, not a proven provider response bound or disk quota; breach is UNKNOWN and never truncation-success

resources: No new container/image/volume/user. Only run bucket/object/policies, new real Auth sessions and explicitly reviewed temporary ACL delta.
acl_review: Not approved. service_role non-DML privileges on seven relations must be addressed before shared schema USAGE; no new table or function privileges.
recovery: Original effective privileges/options/owner grantor; raw NULL schema ACL becomes explicit equivalent owner ACL. Separate acceptance required; never direct catalog repair.

atomic_recovery.snapshot: complete original catalog ABI; comparison under catalog locks on same backend
atomic_recovery.expiry: original reviewed cleanup-only-after-expiry ceiling; no normal authority renewal; hard recovery window never extended
atomic_recovery.window: coordinator-exclusive Storage ACL/DDL window required; database catalogs and cluster-wide role writers may wait
atomic_recovery.unknown: no replay/rollback on quarantined or unidentified stream; close own relay and custodian follow-up
